title: 分離 production CLI 與 MMIS development tools
content: 將四個部分功能的 executable interface 移到 tools/mmis_development，正式 CLI 僅保留 auto-link，底層 reusable components 不動。
userStory: 建立可持續的 MMIS 功能開發與依賴規範

findings: Post-change: 128 passed, 3 optional recorded-DOM tests skipped
20 targeted CLI, development tool, and architecture tests passed
All four development tools import and validate arguments without network access
Reusable and auto-link business modules are unchanged
Architecture, security, test, and code review gates approved
evidence.residual: The four removed production CLI routes are an intentional breaking interface change. Raw git diff --check still reports two pre-existing trailing-whitespace lines in user-modified Prompt.md; task-scoped diff check passed. No Live MMIS validation was needed.

comments.name: 專案使用者
comments.text: 明確核准將四個小功能入口移到 development tools，正式 CLI 僅突出 production auto-link；不得移動 reusable modules。
